subject: Agency sourcing decision + pilot SOW for PR and design
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-10T08:23:00-08:00
Subject: Agency sourcing decision + pilot SOW for PR and design

Team —

Quick context and ask: BrightSpark's PR contract and our two design retainers both expire 31-Mar-2026. Over the last 12 months we've spent ~USD 420k across PR + design, and we continue to see uneven velocity on creative deliverables and mixed outcomes from media placements. Before we commit to another 12-month retainer I want to align on whether we:

- (A) run a compressed RFP for PR + design (targeted shortlist, 2-week response window), or
- (B) authorize a 3–6 month extension with reworked KPIs and milestone payments, or
- (C) pilot a single-source model: PR with one retained agency + one design partner on a short retainer pilot (reduce overlap, standardize SLAs).

I think option C is worth trying for the next quarter to reduce context-switching and get clearer unit economics. Attached: Q1_agency_spend.xlsx and current_sow_brands.pdf for baseline.

Asks:
- Please reply with your recommendation by EOD Wed Feb 18.
- If you support an RFP, confirm you can provide vendor scorecards / evaluation criteria.
- If you support a pilot, Evelyn please propose a pilot SOW and fee model.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Head, Growth Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-11T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Agency sourcing decision + pilot SOW for PR and design

On Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 8:23 AM Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
>
> Quick context and ask: BrightSpark's PR contract and our two design retainers both expire 31-Mar-2026...

Thanks Marcus — good summary. A few data points from marketing:
- BrightSpark has driven consistent coverage in target trade press; last quarter delivered 18 placements and 3 contributed leads tied to campaigns.
- Creative throughput has lagged our roadmap: ~6 assets/month from current design mix, which is below expected 10.
- Total agency fees + freelance spend have crept up; see attached PR_performance_q4.pdf.

My preference is a pragmatic approach: a 3–6 month extension (option B) to avoid disruption while we either run a targeted RFP or pilot the single-source approach. If we extend, I propose: milestone-based payments tied to placements + campaign milestones, and a clear SLA for creative turnarounds (48–72 hours for asset iterations).

If the group leans to an RFP, I can draft the marketing requirements and scorecard (audience, channel mix, creative samples, case studies). If we do a pilot (option C), I'm open to a joint meeting with BrightSpark and PixelForge to set expectations.

Avail for a 30m sync Thu/Fri next week — propose Thu 10–11am PT.

—Laura
VP, Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PR_performance_q4.pdf

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-12T11:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Agency sourcing decision + pilot SOW for PR and design

Marcus / Laura —

Echoing Laura: we need to fix creative throughput and consistency. Quick thoughts on the pilot idea:
- PixelForge (recommended vendor) can run a 3-month design retainer pilot at USD 24k/month. That includes 30 hours/week dedicated designers, two senior reviews/week, and a single point of contact.
- Key ask: include explicit SLAs in the SOW for initial mock turnaround (48 hours), revision cycles (24–48 hours), and a clause for brand guidelines enforcement.
- We should preserve ownership and source files and require a weekly show-and-tell for alignment.

I've attached a draft_pilot_sow_pixelforge.docx that sketches scope, acceptance criteria, and termination for convenience (30-day exit). I flagged pricing and an optional add-on for production support (extra fee).

If we do option B (short extension) I recommend a 3-month extension with milestone payments and a reduced monthly retainer to account for lower forecasted volume.

Evelyn
Head of Design
Redwood Inference

Attachments: draft_pilot_sow_pixelforge.docx

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightSpark PR <maria@brightsparkpr.com>, PixelForge <ops@pixelforge.design>
Date: 2026-02-15T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Agency sourcing decision + pilot SOW for PR and design

Thanks all — consolidating next steps so procurement can move: 

Plan (agreed near-term approach):
- Run a short, targeted RFP but keep the pilot path as Plan B. Release date: Fri Feb 19. Responses due: Thu Mar 5. Evaluation window: Mar 8–12.
- Owners: Laura (marketing requirements + scorecard), Evelyn (design spec + pilot SOW), Tessa (procurement packet & pricing template), Marcus (final approval).
- Required vendor materials: signed NDA, capability deck, three references, pricing spreadsheet, acceptance of our sample SOW terms.

Please upload vendor materials to the linked Drive folder and cc procurement on outreach. I've attached a sample_vendor_packet.pdf that has the NDA and pricing template.

I've looped in vendor contacts to give them a heads-up: BrightSpark (Maria) & PixelForge (ops). Maria / PixelForge — expect an RFP invitation and the procurement packet on Feb 19.

I'll coordinate with Legal for a short amendment template in case we go with a 3-month extension.

Tessa Morgan
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample_vendor_packet.pdf
